# Genuine LibreOffice Base report control

`official-roundtrip-report.orp` was generated by the native LibreOffice
`ReportDefinition` implementation from the `reports/Obj22` storage inside the
official LibreOffice QA database `roundTrip.odb`. It contains eight report design
controls for `Table1`. No report SQL was executed and its XML was not invented or
edited to make the test pass.

The source is pinned by commit, Git blob and SHA-256 in `provenance.json`.
LibreOffice core is distributed under MPL-2.0; the source repository's license
is at <https://github.com/LibreOffice/core/blob/0d51fdc57aef6707466320821b8c2931c00297c0/COPYING.MPL>.
The original copyright remains with its respective LibreOffice contributors.

This is a report-definition preservation control. It does not certify query
results, connected database behavior or rendered layout.
